description:
Checks the Decision Assist override from Eligible to Not Eligible for a single passenger. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before payment, so the case goes to agent Sarah Martin. She finds a record showing that CAD 700 APPR compensation was already paid for AC 412 on Jul 22 through an airport/legacy channel. This record isn't linked in the Claims Dashboard, so the automatic duplicate check didn't catch it. Sarah overrides the decision to Not Eligible and enters a reason of 50 to 500 characters. The original Eligible recommendation stays visible as read-only, and the override is audited with before/after values. She sends "Decision Rendered � Not Eligible" and the case closes as Closed � Not Eligible. No compensation record is created and nothing is paid. Also checks that the reason length is enforced and that only permitted users can override.

Prerequisites:
PNR: OV001 � single passenger Antoine Leblanc (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026 (within 366 days). Case reference: CASE-FD-20260728-101. Claims Dashboard duplicate check: no duplicate (the prior payment is outside CD). Prior payment evidence: legacy / airport record of CAD 700 APPR paid Jul 22, 2026 (reference LEG-APPR-55821). CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Users: Sarah Martin (Agent with case.render_decision), Paul Girard (read-only user without case.render_decision).
